> **Flows 01 and 02 and the state inventory are superseded as of 3 Aug 2026.** Rebuilt against the requirements amendment — see docs 26 and 27. Replacement diagrams are attached to [MAC-22](https://linear.app/hintology/issue/MAC-22/refine-designs-against-requirements-amendment) as `doc21-REPLACE-flow-01-first-run.png`, `doc21-REPLACE-flow-02-core-loop.png` and `doc21-REPLACE-state-inventory.png`. Two specific corrections: flow 01 is **not** an unexitable modal (skipping targets is a supported end state), and flow 02 now has three entry paths rather than one.

Every screen in the order someone actually meets it. Six flows, 27 screens — 25 drawn, 2 specified and still undrawn.

Navigation rules come from doc 19: **Today is the only root**, and only capture and the pre-session stack are modal. Every push returns to Today.

**Read the connectors literally.** `→` is a transition a user can make. Screens grouped under a *Siblings* or *States* heading are **not** sequential — they hang off the same parent, or they are alternate states of one screen.

| Marker | Meaning |
| -- | -- |
| `→` | A transition a user can make |
| Siblings / States group | Not steps — alternates off one parent |

## Flow 01 — First run: no account to first meal

**MODAL · CANNOT BE EXITED**

The longest path in the app and the only one a user walks once. Everything from Welcome to Targets is a modal stack with no menu and no way out except finishing — a half-onboarded account has no targets, so there is nothing coherent to show behind it.

**Sequence**

`6a Welcome` → `6b Register` → `6c Verify email` → `6e Ten questions` → `6f Building targets` → `6g Your targets` → `4a Home — first run`

| Screen | Note |
| -- | -- |
| 6a Welcome | Sign in with Apple takes the top slot |
| 6b Register | One screen, two modes. Toggle to Login |
| 6c Verify email | Blocking. Resend carries a visible cooldown |
| 6e Ten questions | One per screen, three control types |
| 6f Building targets | Formula first, then the AI pass |
| 6g Your targets | Three numbers and the reasoning |
| 4a Home — first run | **NOT DRAWN.** Specified in doc 12 as a state of 4a |

**Detours** — opened from 6b and 6g, not from the step before them.

| Screen | Opened from | Note |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 6d Reset password | 6b | Confirmation never leaks whether the address exists |
| 6h Adjust targets | 6g | Never forces acceptance of a generated number |

**Branches**

| At | When | Goes to |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 6a | Already has an account | 6b in Login mode |
| 6b | Forgot password | 6d Reset → back to 6b |
| 6b | Email already registered | Inline error, stays on 6b |
| 6c | Email never arrives | Resend, 60s cooldown |
| 6e | Back on question 1 | Nowhere — no exit from the stack |
| 6g | The numbers look wrong | 6h Adjust → back to 6g |
| 6h | Pushed outside safe bounds | Orange bounds line; saving still allowed |
| 4a | First meal logged | Flow 02 |

## Flow 02 — The core loop: log a meal

**MODAL STACK OVER TODAY**

Ninety percent of all sessions. Four screens, three of which the user should never have to think about. Cancel at any point drops the entire stack back to Today — there is no half-saved entry.

**Sequence**

`4a Today` → `5a Capture` → `5b Analyzing` → `8e Review` → `4a Today, updated`

| Screen | Note |
| -- | -- |
| 4a Today | ＋ Log food, pinned bottom |
| 5a Capture | Camera and library, equal billing |
| 5b Analyzing | 3–6s synchronous. Pipeline states named |
| 8e Review | Portion first, then steppers |
| 4a Today, updated | Ring redraws. Over-target state shown (8d) |

**Interrupts** — fire from 5a / 5b / 8e, not from the step before them.

| Screen | Note |
| -- | -- |
| 5c Review, medium confidence | Same screen as 8e before the portion row; CHECK THE PORTION strip |
| 5d Re-prompt | From 8e when the food itself was read wrong |
| 7h Edge states | Six global interrupts; four can fire inside this flow |

**Branches**

| At | When | Goes to |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 5a | Camera permission denied | 7h permission state → library |
| 5b | Analysis fails or times out | 7h failure → retry or describe by hand |
| 5b | Daily AI quota reached | 7h quota state → manual entry |
| 5b | No connection | 7h offline → queued, saves on reconnect |
| 8e | The food itself was read wrong | 5d Re-prompt → back to 8e |
| 8e | Portion was wrong, not the food | One tap scales all four macros |
| 8e | Cancel | Whole stack drops → Today |

## Flow 03 — Looking back at what you logged

**PUSH OFF TODAY**

Two ways in — an entry row for one meal, the date title for a whole day. Both return to Today. This is also the only place the raw AI response is exposed, which is what makes a wrong estimate arguable rather than mysterious.

**Sequence**

`4a Today` → `7a Entry detail` → `7b Delete entry` → `4a Today`

| Screen | Note |
| -- | -- |
| 4a Today | Tap an entry row, or the date title |
| 7a Entry detail | Photo at real size. Estimate vs saved |
| 7b Delete entry | Names consequences, not "are you sure" |
| 4a Today | Totals drop; streak effect stated up front |

**Branches**

| At | When | Goes to |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 4a | Date title tapped | Calendar sheet → any past day |
| Past day | Nothing was logged that day | Empty-day state, backfill from library |
| 7a | Re-analyze | 5b Analyzing → 8e Review |
| 7a | Estimate vs saved | Exposes `ai_raw_response` inline |
| 7b | Deleting the only entry on a day | Streak effect stated before confirming |

## Flow 04 — Moving around the app

**OVERLAY, THEN PUSH**

There is no tab bar. One ≡ opens the menu; every destination is one tap from there and returns to Today. ＋ Log food is pinned to the menu too, so capture never costs more than two taps from anywhere.

**Sequence**

`4a Today` → `8a Menu`

**Siblings off 8a** — each returns to Today, not to each other.

| Screen | Note |
| -- | -- |
| 8b History | **Parked** — not settled for MVP. A week card pushes *Week detail* (**never drawn**) |
| 8c Streak | **Parked** — not settled for MVP |
| 7d Targets | Append-only version history |
| 7c Settings | Health toggle, quota, photo storage |

**Branches**

| At | When | Goes to |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 8a | Any row tapped | Pushes; back always returns to Today |
| 8a | ＋ Log food | Flow 02, modal over Today |
| 8b | A week card tapped | Week detail — specified, not drawn |
| 4a | Streak chip tapped | 8c Streak directly |
| 8b / 8c | MVP scope | Both parked; doc 20 marked NOT SETTLED |

## Flow 05 — Day close and the reason to come back

**PUSH · DEEP LINK**

The only surface that speaks to the user rather than being read by them. Layers 1 and 2 are deterministic and always free; layer 3 is the coaching pass and unlocks on four logged weeks rather than on payment.

**Sequence**

`4a Today, evening` → Recap (one screen, two states) → `4a Today`

| Screen | State | Note |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 7f Recap | Layer 3 locked | Layers 1–2 in full. Layer 3 shows WEEK n OF 4 |
| 7g Recap | Layer 3 unlocked | Encouragement, one swap, tomorrow |

**Branches**

| At | When | Goes to |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Notification | Morning recap tapped | Pushes 7f onto Today, not instead of it |
| 7f | Fewer than 4 logged weeks | Progress bar and unlock date; nothing to buy |
| 7f | Four logged weeks reached | 7g, permanently |
| 7f | Day had no entries | No recap generated at all |

## Flow 06 — Account, data and leaving

**PUSH · STORE-REQUIRED**

Rarely visited, and both stores require the last screen to exist in-app. Delete is laid out as a timeline — now, thirty days, then gone — with a typed confirmation, because it is the one irreversible action in the product.

**Sequence**

`8a Menu` → `7c Settings`

**Siblings off 7c** — both pushed from Settings.

| Screen | Note |
| -- | -- |
| 7d Target history | Every version, its range, and why it changed |
| 7e Delete account | Typed confirmation. Button inert until typed |

**Branches**

| At | When | Goes to |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 7c | Health toggled on | Write-only permission prompt; never reads |
| 7c | Quota bar tapped | Explains the daily AI limit |
| 7e | Confirmed | 30-day window, then permanent |
| Any screen | Session expires | 7h session state → 6b Login |

## State inventory

Every screen with more than one state, and where each one is drawn. The six global states can interrupt any flow — they are the ones most likely to be missed on a first TestFlight build.

| Screen | State | What changes | Drawn |
| -- | -- | -- | -- |
| Today | Normal | Ring, two tiles, entry list | 4a |
| Today | First run / empty day | NOTHING LOGGED YET, tiles read —, backfill CTA | **NOT DRAWN** |
| Today | Over calorie target | Outer ring full; overage as inner arc; numeral flips to OVER BY | 8d |
| Today | Offline | Queued-entry banner above the ring | 7h |
| Review | High confidence | Portion row defaults to Right; no warning | 8e |
| Review | Medium confidence | CHECK THE PORTION strip over the photo | 5c |
| Review | Edited | Confidence flips to EDITED; `ai_raw_response` kept | 8e |
| Recap | Layer 3 locked | WEEK n OF 4 progress bar; nothing to buy | 7f |
| Recap | Layer 3 unlocked | Encouragement, one swap, tomorrow | 7g |
| Targets | Within bounds | Baseline → set line in dim mono | 6g |
| Targets | Outside safe bounds | Bounds line turns orange; save still permitted | 6h |
| Entry detail | Saved vs estimate | Exposes the raw model response | 7a |
| Entry detail | Delete confirm | Photo, totals and streak consequences named | 7b |
| Global | Camera permission denied | Explains why, offers library instead | 7h |
| Global | Analysis failed | Retry, or describe the meal by hand | 7h |
| Global | AI quota reached | Manual entry stays available all day | 7h |
| Global | Offline queue | Entry saved locally, syncs on reconnect | 7h |
| Global | Session expired | Returns to Login, preserves the queue | 7h |
| Global | Destructive confirm | Consequences named, never "are you sure" | 7h |

## Gaps this map exposes

**Two screens are specified and never drawn.** The empty / first-run variant of Today, and Week detail behind a History card. The first is what a brand-new user stares at for the ten seconds before their first photo, which makes it the highest-value undrawn thing in the set.

**Flow 04 is half-parked.** History and Streak are drawn but explicitly not settled for MVP. If they are cut, the menu drops to six rows and the return loop rests entirely on the recap gate in flow 05 — worth deciding before build rather than during it.

**Every branch in flow 02 is a failure branch.** Five of seven. That is correct for a camera-and-network product, but it means the capture stack carries more error handling than happy path, and the offline queue in particular is still backend design rather than screen design.

**Nothing here covers multi-device.** The data model is append-only, but no flow answers what happens when the same day is edited on a phone and an iPad. It is out of scope for MVP; it should be written down as out of scope rather than left unasked.
